data.description:
## Why

The eval specs and gold-set expectations assert against criterion PROMPT text. Once the
reviewer prompts drop SC vocabulary, any spec still phrased in SC terms is describing a rubric
that no longer exists, and the eval solver actively MANUFACTURES the dual vocabulary into every
fixture ticket it generates — reintroducing the heading the migration is removing.

## What

Update the eval specs, the eval solver's generated fixture descriptions, and the gold-set
expectation strings to the collapsed vocabulary.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/plan-review-container.eval.yaml:6,91,93,205`
- `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/plan-review-g7.eval.yaml:36`
- `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py:308` — currently emits
  `"## Acceptance Criteria\n- [ ] {etext}\n\n## Success Criteria\n- {etext}"`, i.e. every
  generated fixture carries both headings with duplicated text.
- `tests/unit/gold_set_completion.py:101,382` — expectation strings
  ("del-b's success criteria could be sized into two tasks", "fc1's success criteria could be split").

## Approach

Specs and gold-set strings are straight vocabulary edits. `eval_solver.py:308` drops the
trailing `## Success Criteria` block entirely rather than renaming it — the two blocks carried
the SAME `{etext}`, so emitting both under one heading would duplicate every criterion.

The gold-set strings are EXPECTATIONS, not inputs: changing them changes what the gold set
scores. They are edited only because the underlying rubric wording changed, and the story
verifies the gold set still scores as before rather than assuming it.

## Testing

- `pytest tests/unit/gold_set_completion.py tests/unit -k "eval or gold"` green.
- Confirm the gold-set pass/fail tallies are UNCHANGED versus the pre-change baseline, proving
  the edits were vocabulary-only and did not move any expectation.
- Assert a solver-generated fixture description now contains exactly one criteria heading.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `grep -rniE "success[ _-]criteri(a|on)" src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/ src/rebar/llm/evals/` returns no matches.
- [ ] `grep -n "success criteria" tests/unit/gold_set_completion.py` returns no matches.
- [ ] A solver-generated fixture description contains `## Acceptance Criteria` exactly once and
      no `## Success Criteria`, asserted by a test over `eval_solver`'s output.
- [ ] The gold-set score tally is identical to the pre-change baseline (recorded in a ticket
      comment before the edit, compared after).
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck` and the full pytest suite pass.
data.title: Point heading-detection code and its test corpus at Acceptance Criteria
